borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved drawings) and 7 (Juliet balcony) of planning permission ref: 2024/02631/FUL granted 7th May 2025 for the 'Erection of a front roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey side and rear extension following the demolition of the existing rear extension; installation of new rooflight above the main flat roof at roof level and above the roof of second floor rear back addition; infilling of the existing rooflights and installation of French doors and a Juliet balcony in the rear roofslope; de-conversion of the existing building from 2no self-contained flats into a single family dwellinghouse' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: re-location and alterations to the design of French doors, and changing the materials of the Juliet balcony from metal balustrade (flushed) to glass balustrade projecting outward of the rear roofslope; omission of the rooflight above the roof of second floor rear back addition, alterations to the design and re-location of the window to the rear elevation of second floor back addition; re-location of 1no rooflight and installation of an additional rooflight above the roof of the approved ground floor rear back addition; alterations to the rear fenestration of the ground floor extension to include the replacement of bi-folding doors with sliding doors and alterations to the design of the clear glazed panel at the rear elevation; installation of 2no telescopic vents in the rear garden.
